publicReleaseNotes: Oncall 0.4.1: a backup made by the previous version now restores. The retained backup from the currently listed version and a fresh export are checked against empty migrated databases, including installations managed by Platform. Updates the pinned rer runtime and vendored Base modules to 0.2.68. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/oncall-0.4.0-incident-1440.png

agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.4.0, back up first with rer export --output exports/before-0.4.1.rer. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev. For hosted installations, retain a verified hosted D1 export and private settings, then run git pull --ff-only and rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT from the original deploying checkout with the same credentials. Main also carries migration 0127 for installation-local signed-source credential custody; keep every applied migration byte unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. A backup made by the previous version now restores into a fresh empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.4.1.rer --yes. Restore retains authored records and import history; credentials and sessions do not transfer, and receiving integrations remain inactive until locally authorized. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. To update from 0.3.0, back up first: locally with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer`; for a hosted installation export its D1 database with `npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql` (the name is in `.rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json`) using the deploying Cloudflare credentials. Locally, stop `rer dev` with Ctrl-C, run `git pull --ff-only`, then `rer dev`. Hosted, from the checkout that deployed, run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT` with the same credentials; the owner, schedules and incidents are kept. The update applies ten additive migrations (0117-0126); keep all 32 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Restore a backup only into an empty destination (`rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` locally, a fresh empty installation when hosted). Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. From 0.2.0, stop with `rer dev --stop` and `rer preview --stop`, then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. The update applies four additive migrations (0113–0116); keep all 22 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Data, the owner and password accounts are kept. People who sign in with a workspace password sign in once more, because the held session cookie is now named `oncall_session_<port>`. Captured local sign-in mail is removed with the development outbox; open the app with the `RER_OPEN` link that `rer dev` prints. To update from 0.1.0, stop the old servers before pulling with `node scripts/rer.mjs dev --stop` and `node scripts/rer.mjs preview --stop`, install the global rer command with `curl -fsSL https://runeditrun.com/install.sh | sh` (or `npm install -g @runeditrun/rer`), then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. Back up first with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer` (0.1.0: `node scripts/rer.mjs export --output exports/NAME.rer` while its servers are stopped). Restore only into an empty destination with `rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` after restoring the original private settings. For hosted coordination, follow Install and run → Host for your team: configure remote sign-in mail and run `rer deploy` with your Cloudflare credentials; rer claims the owner and retires the setup token. Open the app address and sign in by emailed link, or with `rer signin`. Update an existing hosted installation with `rer deploy`, preserving its owner and data. Remove with `rer deploy --remove --yes` and confirm its empty readback. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Independent standby and paging delivery are outside this release.
